question: Should Discord component callbacks default to 7 days and allow explicit 30-day overrides for existing deployments?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it intentionally changes how long old visible Discord controls can trigger authorized callback work after upgrade, so automation should not choose the stale-action policy.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Approve the 7-day default and 30-day maximum, then require the stale gateway config reference and dirty merge state to be fixed before merge.

options.title: Keep old default
options.body: Preserve the 30-minute default and rely on explicit per-deployment `agentComponents.ttlMs` overrides for async workflows.

options.title: Choose a smaller bound
options.body: Use a shorter default or maximum and align runtime, schema, docs, generated metadata, and tests around that chosen policy.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the 7-day default and 30-day maximum, then require the stale gateway config reference and dirty merge state to be fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and documented the prior TTL config work and are the best evidenced owner for the policy/config-docs decision path.
